data.body: Confirmed stuck-bug hypothesis: 3rd independent epic review (signed_at 1788038284597143000) reports the SAME foreign HEAD (f1dd41a8f09967dd60c7aefb5e43c6f62fa119af) as the first two attempts, ~50 minutes apart total. Stopping further paid review-plan retries on the epic - this is a rebar tooling defect (bug seaworthy-revengeful-blobfish filed), not a real staleness or a plan-quality issue, and cannot be forced past per agent policy. Reporting to user as blocked. State at stop: undamaged-adept-xenarthra and celestine-treasonous-ewe both certified (plan-review PASS, signed) but NOT claimed (blocked by parent-claim cascade requiring the epic's own claim first). Epic itself has a clean content PASS (0 blocking findings) but cannot sign. No code changes made yet - session stayed entirely within Phase 0-2 (preflight, environment setup, epic-level claim gate).
